mono.subject: 03-software
mono.title: 软件：工具、界面与人的创造

phrase.zh: 工具的下一种样子，由人写下。
phrase.en: People write the next shape of their tools.

visual.zh: 手、屏幕和交叠窗口共同表达软件制作：抽象规则最终变成可操作的工具。画面中的界面是构图元素，不对应一款真实软件或可执行程序。
visual.en: Hands, screens and overlapping windows connect abstract rules with usable tools. The depicted interfaces are compositional elements, not a real application or executable program.

background.zh: 计算机历史博物馆记载，约翰·巴克斯领导的 IBM 团队在 1957 年推出 FORTRAN，以接近英语的语句支持科学计算。编程语言让人可以用更高层次的表达描述计算，而不必逐条安排底层机器操作。
background.en: The Computer History Museum records the IBM team led by John Backus developing FORTRAN in 1957. Its English-like statements served scientific computing. Programming languages let people express calculations at a higher level instead of specifying every low-level machine operation.
